convert_depth_log_from_world: convert world-space depth values to normalized log-scale using LogTransform.from_world with a depth range
convert_depth_log_to_world: convert normalized log-scale depth values back to world-space using LogTransform.to_world with a depth range
convert_depth_linear_from_world: normalize world-space depth to a 0-1 range using LinearTransform.from_world with a depth range
convert_depth_linear_to_world: denormalize 0-1 depth values back to world-space using LinearTransform.to_world with a depth range
review_depth_transformations: review the LogTransform and LinearTransform classes for depth normalization and denormalization utilities
